newsitem.title: FINLAND: POHJOLA, SAMPO TO OUTPERFORM - GS.
newsitem.headline: POHJOLA, SAMPO TO OUTPERFORM - GS.

text.p: Goldman Sachs is rating Finnish insurance groups Vakuutusosakeyhtio Pohjola and Vakuutusosakeyhtio Sampo "market outperformers", the investment bank said in a research note dated on October 29.
"We reiterate our market outperformer rating on Pohjola and we initiate coverage of Sampo with a market outperformer rating," Goldman Sachs said.
It said it has a 139 markka target price for Pohjola, and a 388-430 markka target range for Sampo.
Sampo's target price depended on the value accorded to the future life business, it said.
At 1405/1205, Pohjola's more liquid B share traded unchanged at 96.50 markka, and Sampo was unchanged at 320.00 markka.
